outcome.summary: Removed or repaired six stale, ordinary-global, non-null, and type-erasing suppression sites. Two noExplicitAny tRPC fixture regions remain governed because the production builders accept the full generated client rather than a narrow port; replacing the suppressions would require fabricating unrelated procedures or changing the product boundary.

repairs.result: buildAgentPlugin now exposes the two-read port it actually consumes; the fake derives that port and its mock signatures without fabricating the rest of AppRouter or using noExplicitAny.
Postfix non-null assertions were replaced with explicit guards and narrowed bindings.
The ordinary module imports node:process and its two noProcessGlobal suppressions were removed; hoisted pre-import sites remain governed.
The redundant format and useAwait suppressions were removed.

Added the missing tests useExplicitReturnType grant, retired the dead noNonNullAssertion grant, and narrowed the surviving noProcessGlobal, noExplicitAny, useAwait, naming, and bitwise rationales to their actual boundaries.

The product builder was narrowed to its real two-read port, branded fixture ids now pass the canonical TypeID parser, and both affected native programs plus the focused type and unit suites pass.
